text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives a message on bilateral ties from Sudanese leader General Omar Hassan al-Bashir.
- Iraq's National Assembly Speaker Saadoun Hammadi urges Russia to lessen the American domination in the U.N. Security Council.
- Saddam congratulates the Chinese president on the return of Hong Kong.
- Iraqi ports in the Gulf are ready to receive travellers.
- An Indonesian delegation grants medicines to Iraq.
